newsitem.title: USA: TCI close to partnership deals - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: TCI close to partnership deals - WSJ.

text.p: Tele-Communications Inc is close to executing a series of partnerships with Time Warner Inc and others that will allow it lower its debt by more than $1.1 billion and would shrink its subscriber base by 800,000, the Wall Street Journal said.

In Tuesday's electronic edition, the Journal said that under the plan, TCI can dipose of cable systems in markets it does not dominate, and that the new partners may benefit from managing systems that abut markets they already serve.
TCI would be a minority partner in the ventures, which include TCA Cable TV Inc, Falcon Cable Systems LP and Charter Communications International Inc, the Journal said.
Eventually, the partners would have an opportunity to buy out TCI or vice versa, the Journal said.

Although the cable company would lose a share of the cash flow generated by the systems, the ventures would allow it to lower its $14 billion debt load. In addition, its debt-to-cash-flow ratio could drop to a more comfortable five times cash flow.
